details.title: Night King
details.description:
The year is 2012. The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the clubâs manager, Foon (Dayo Wong), despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades.

To make things worse for Foon, the clubâs new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife, Madame V (Sammi Cheng)! Determined to change things up, she leaves Foon and his hostesses with no choice but to transform and modernize in order to breathe new life into their business. Little do they know, a powerful conglomerate has been pulling the strings all along to shut down Club EJ for good.

To save their neon empire, Foon and V must join forces and make an epic last stand with the hostesses against what seems to be inevitable doom.

details.description: COLD WAR, the highest grossing Hong Kong film in 2012, went on to win 9 major awards in the Hong Kong Film Awards, including Best Film, Best Director, Best Screenplay and Best Actor for Tony Leung Ka Fai. 4 years later, the story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. But the mastermind remains unknown, until the resurface of a former police chief who unveils an unprecedented scheme to corrupt the police force. Things get more complicated when senior counsel Oswald Kan (Chow Yun Fat) leads an impeachment proceeding against Sean. Oswaldâs every decision is pivotal in determining who stays on top of the game.

details.name: Punching the World(GFF 2026)
details.title: Punching the World(GFF 2026)
details.description:
Germany / 2024 
 

In early-2000s eastern Germany, brothers Philipp (12) and Tobias (9) watch their family slowly break apart while building an unfinished house. Unemployment, silence, and old wounds leave the boys alone in vast fields and clear quarry waters that offer brief freedom. Nature feels endless, but real guidance is scarce. Older youths draw Philipp in with promises of belongingâyet their path carries violence and fear of outsiders. As a refugee shelter is planned nearby, quiet tensions turn sharp. A clear-eyed, tender portrait of youth caught between loss, nature, and the hard search for a place to stand.

details.name: Red Stars upon the field(GFF 2026)
details.title: Red Stars upon the field(GFF 2026)
details.description:
Germany / 2024 
 

In the heart of rural East Germany, a remarkably preserved skeleton surfaces from the moor, sparking fevered village guesses: a Wehrmacht deserter, a farmer who defied collectivization, or the shadowy third man from a long-ago intelligence operation? Laura Laabsâ striking debut transforms this discovery into a quietly gripping historical puzzle, where echoes of the entire twentieth century suddenly flicker into the present. Tine, at first detached, soon finds the weight of buried eras pressing inescapably into her own life. Atmospheric, introspective and subtly unnerving, the film reveals how history never truly stays underground.

In 1970s East Berlin, single mother Paula and unhappily married functionary Paul keep missing each other in the same streets â until a chance encounter in a smoky bar sparks an intense, life-changing romance. Paula, fierce in her pursuit of joy, refuses to settle; Paul, torn between duty and desire, hesitates before finally embracing the depth of what they share. Heiner Carowâs DEFA classic pulses with groovy energy, bold fashion, and irresistible music that launched the Puhdys to stardom. A warm, rebellious celebration of personal happiness against socialist conformity, this cult phenomenon became a defiant anthem for individual freedom â nearly too subversive for its time.

KOMA was a brand that Ruiâs family had lovingly preserved over generations and a symbol of happiness for all. However, not to mention financial backing, too many clues are missing to revive the whisky once lost. Rui, Kotaro, and the distillery supporters pull together every thread to bring back the whisky filled with family memories.

Behind the glamour of nighttime escapades, he conceals an illness with wit and humor. Though time is slipping through his fingers, he refuses to slow down. He composes masterpieces while teaching to make ends meet. details.name: King Frankie (EUFF2026)
details.title: King Frankie (EUFF2026)
details.description:
Following the death of his father, Frankie Burke, a kindly Dublin taxi driver, is forced to confront the ghosts of his past when an unexpected stranger arrives at his door. Ten years earlier, Frankie lived a wildly extravagant life, losing money as quickly as he made it, oblivious to the concerns of family and friends, until a tragic climax caused his world to tumble down. Dermot Maloneâs ultimately hopeful parable about greed, guilt, and redemption, is served well by the ever-versatile Peter Coonan who conjures the many faces of Frankie with ease in this powerful character study.

 

Irish Film and Television Awards: Two Nominations

Shanghai International Film Festival

details.name: Late Shift (EUFF2026)
details.title: Late Shift (EUFF2026)
details.description:
Nurse Floria works with passion and professionalism in a Swiss hospital. She has an open ear for patients, even in stressful situations, and is immediately on hand in an emergency â ideally. But in the harsh reality, things are often unpredictable. When she starts her late shift one day, a colleague is absent from the fully occupied, understaffed ward. Amidst the hustle, Floria looks after a seriously ill young mother and an old man desperately waiting for his diagnosis with the same care as a private patient with extra demands. As the night progresses, her work becomes a race against time.

 

Berlin International Film Festival

Locarno Film Festival

details.name: Punching the World (EUFF2026)
details.title: Punching the World (EUFF2026)
details.description:
In early 2000s eastern Germany, brothers Philipp and Tobias watch their family slowly break apart while building an unfinished house. Unemployment, silence, and old wounds leave the boys alone in vast fields and clear quarry waters that offer brief freedom. Nature feels endless, but real guidance is scarce. Older youths draw Philipp in with promises of belonging â yet their path carries violence and fear of outsiders. As a refugee shelter is planned nearby, quiet tensions turn sharp. A clear-eyed, tender portrait of youth caught between loss, nature, and the hard search for a place to stand.

 

Berlin International Film Festival

German Film Criticsâ Award: Best Actor

details.title: U Are the Universe (EUFF2026)
details.description:
In the near future, Ukrainian space trucker Andriy Melnyk transports nuclear waste on the cargo ship to the abandoned Jupiter's moon Callisto. During his routine flight, the Earth explodes, but Andriy manages to survive. Andriy thinks he has become the last person in the universe until French woman Catherine calls him from the faraway space station. Andriy decides to see her despite all obstacles. Filmed during the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine, this feature debut from young filmmaker Pavlo Ostrikov is an ode to love in dark times.

 

Ukrainian Film Critics Awards: Four Awards, including Best Feature Film

Toronto International Film Festival

details.name: The Old Oak (bcSunday)
details.title: The Old Oak (bcSunday)
details.description: The Old Oak is a special place. Not only is it the last pub standing, it is the only remaining public space where people can meet in a once thriving mining community that has now fallen on hard times after 30 years of decline. TJ Ballantyne (Dave Turner) the landlord hangs on to The Old Oak by his fingertips, and his hold is endangered even more when the pub becomes contested territory after the arrival of Syrian refugees who are placed in the village. An unlikely friendship develops when TJ encounters a young Syrian with a camera, Yara (Ebla Mari). Can they find a way for the two communities to understand each other? So unfolds a deeply moving drama about loss, fear and the difficulty of finding hope.

After Ryuichi Sakamoto created a massive buzz with Playing the Orchestra 2013, in which he performed with a full orchestra, he updated the concert the following year, conducting the orchestra by himself while playing the piano. A feature-length concert film with an exceptional soundscape, Ryuichi Sakamoto | Playing the Orchestra 2014 vividly captures that celebrated 2014 Tokyo concert.

This iconic concert featured a wide range of the maestroâs music, from Yellow Music Orchestra's classics to beloved masterpieces such as Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence and The Last Emperor, all performed with the grandeur of the Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra. Immerse yourself into the world of Ryuichi Sakamotoâs music and witness a master creating legacy in real time.

details.description:
Who is Mr. Badii, really? A desperate man, a wise one? Driving his 4Ã4, he roams the majestic Iranian landscapes around Tehran in search of someone willing to lend him a hand with a particular task, in exchange for a reward. Everyone he encounters reacts to his proposal in a different way.

details.description: Longing for more after his Elvis epic biopic starring Austin Butler, Luhrmann follows up with EPiC, an electric and revealing concert documentary. Recovering 60-plus boxes of never-before-seen concert archives from Warner Brosâ storage, the director showcases his kaleidoscopic visual kinks and aggressive editing styles, seamlessly stitching together performances from several concerts from different eras to offer a panoramic view of his life and career. A mesmerising picture showing the King of Rock ânâ Rollâs hypnotic stage presence and generous personality all at once, it is a fitting tribute to applaud the showmanship of Elvis â and Luhrmann too.

details.description: ELVIS is an epic, big-screen spectacle from Warner Bros. Pictures and visionary, Oscar-nominated filmmaker Baz Luhrmann that explores the life and music of Elvis Presley, starring Austin Butler and Oscar winner Tom Hanks. A thoroughly cinematic drama, Elvisâs (Butler) story is seen through the prism of his complicated relationship with his enigmatic manager, Colonel Tom Parker (Hanks). As told by Parker, the film delves into the complex dynamic between the two spanning over 20 years, from Presleyâs rise to fame to his unprecedented stardom, against the backdrop of the evolving cultural landscape and loss of innocence in America. Central to that journey is one of the significant and influential people in Elvisâs life, Priscilla Presley (Olivia DeJonge).

details.name: A Pale View of Hills
details.title: A Pale View of Hills
details.description:
In 1982 England, young writer Niki (Camilla Ako) returns home to visit her mother, Etsuko (Yo Yoshida), who has decided to sell the family house after years of loss. As they sift through old mementoes, memories of post-war Nagasaki 30 years ago resurface. Young Etsuko's (Suzu Hirose) story begins with her encounter with Sachiko (Fumi Nikaido), a mysterious woman longing to start anew abroad with her daughter. As Niki pieces together these recollections, she senses troubling inconsistencies in the story. Adapted from Nobel laureate Kazuo Ishiguroâs work and directed by Kei Ishikawa (A Man), the film weaves dual timelines to portray womenâs struggles in the shadow of war, reflecting the collective trauma of a turbulent age. Un Certain Regard, Cannes.

details.description:
A 1987 film directed and co-written by Bernardo Bertolucci, THE LAST EMPEROR was the biopic of Pu-Yi, The Last Emperor of China. Its story, based on his autobiography, tells how Pu-Yi ascended to the throne at the age of three. In his brief reign, he was confined to the Forbidden City, not knowing of the world of his people. When he is forced to abdicate at nine, the rest of Pu-Yi's life is one of desolation and impoverishment. After serving as the ruler of a Japanese puppet government of China during World War II, he becomes a political prisoner of the Soviets and then of the Communist Chinese. When finally released in the 1960's, Pu-Yi dies in obscurity...

 

This proved very successful at the Oscars, winning all nine of its nominations, including Best Picture, tying the record set by Gigi nearly thirty years earlier. The digitally remastered version of THE LAST EMPEROR is hitting the screens now!

details.title: Pegasus 3
details.description:
After the final stage at Bayanbulak, Zhang Chi (played by Shen Teng) is invited to compete in a brand-new event, the âMuchen 100 Rally,â as the head coach of the team. The once âwildâ racer now steps onto the international stage.


Facing a completely new course filled with top-tier competitors, Sun Yuqiang (played by Yin Zheng) and Ji Xing (played by Zhang Benyu) once again fight side by side with Zhang Chi. Powerful drivers such as Lin Zhendong (played by Huang Jingyu) are also invited to join, and a team built on top-level speed and shared belief is formed.

 

However, Zhang Chi soon realizes that the true challenge does not seem to come from the race itself. Beneath the surface, tensions are rising beyond the track, casting uncertainty over their high-speed journey ahead.

details.description:
From acclaimed writer Charlie Kaufman and visionary director Michel Gondry comes Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind. An all-star ensemble cast shines in this comical and poignant look at breakups, breakdowns and breakthroughs. Joel is stunned to discover that his girlfriend, Clementine, has had their tumultuous relationship erased from her mind. Out of desperation, he contacts the inventor of the process, Dr. Howard Mierzwiak, to get the same treatment. But as his memories of Clementine begin to fade, Joel suddenly realizes how much he still loves her.

 

One-hour post-screening talk by Wong Kim Fan, lecturer at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, conducted in Cantonese.

details.name: As the Water Flows
details.title: As the Water Flows
details.description:
The debut feature from cinematographer Bian Zhuo won Best Film in the Asian New Talent Competition at the Shanghai International Film Festival. Bian also served as screenwriter, editor and director of photography for this elegiac drama about Xie Shuwen, an elderly widower who considers a new romance one year after the passing of his wife. However, his decision is fraught, sowing discontent among his grown children, complicating a web of family matters, and bringing to light past hardships. Facing emotional difficulties and uncooperative health, Xie strives to heal his family and himself before life's light fades.

 

Best Film Award, Asian New Talent Competition, Shanghai International Film Festival
Vancouver International Film Festival
New Talent Award, Hong Kong Asian Film Festival

details.name: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
details.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
details.description:
Set in 18th century France, Marianne, a young painter, is commissioned to paint a wedding portrait of a young noblewoman and reluctant bride to be, HeÌloiÌse. Knowing that HeÌloiÌse has just come out of a convent and has previously refused to sit for portraits, Marianne disguises herself as the ladyâs companion by day in order to paint her portrait from memory by night.

 

Intimacy and attraction grow between the two women, they ignite in each other feelings that are passionate yet forbidden. As they share HeÌloiÌseâs first and last moments of freedom, all whilst Marianne paints the portrait that will end it all. Drawing on the story of Orpheus and Eurydice, director CeÌline Sciamma flips the male gaze in Hitchcockâs Vertigo and presents a film that is based entirely on the female gaze: a gaze of artistic appropriation, of inquisition, and of unstoppable desires.

details.title: CIAO UFO
details.description: Wah Fu Estate in Aberdeen is the home of many urban legends, but few were as outlandish as the one that happened in the 1980s: One night, residents turned their heads to the sky and saw a giant UFO hovering above them for five minutes. No one else could prove or explain the odd phenomenon, but it becomes the pivotal event for three young people in this long-awaited return to form for director Patrick Leung (La Brassiere, Simply Actors). This charming sci-fi comedy also marks the reunion of Tsui Tien-you, Wong Younam and Charlene Choi, who co-starred in 2002 teen comedy hit Summer Breeze of Love.

details.description:
Set in 18th century France, Marianne, a young painter, is commissioned to paint a wedding portrait of a young noblewoman and reluctant bride to be, HeÌloiÌse. Knowing that HeÌloiÌse has just come out of a convent and has previously refused to sit for portraits, Marianne disguises herself as the ladyâs companion by day in order to paint her portrait from memory by night.

 

Intimacy and attraction grow between the two women, they ignite in each other feelings that are passionate yet forbidden. As they share HeÌloiÌseâs first and last moments of freedom, all whilst Marianne paints the portrait that will end it all. Drawing on the story of Orpheus and Eurydice, director CeÌline Sciamma flips the male gaze in Hitchcockâs Vertigo and presents a film that is based entirely on the female gaze: a gaze of artistic appropriation, of inquisition, and of unstoppable desires.

 

Each ticket includes an A3 international and French poster.

details.name: Sentimental Value
details.title: Sentimental Value
details.description:
Following the Academy Award-nominated sensation The Worst Person in the World, Joachim Trier reunites with Renate Reinsve for this Cannes Grand Jury Prize winner. 

Nora Borg is an established Oslo stage actress; her younger sister Agnes is her closest companion. The two grew up together after their once-renowned filmmaker father Gustav left the family years earlier. When Gustav re-enters their lives and attempts to cast Nora in his comeback film, old wounds bleed anew. Nora rejects his offer, prompting Gustav to cast American star Rachel Kemp, who gradually comes to realize she has unwittingly become part of a deeply personal film drama. Agnes, meanwhile, delves deeper into the family history as Gustav and Nora attempt rapprochement, revealing a past that threatens the fragile foundations of the family.

details.name: The World Of Love
details.title: The World Of Love
details.description:
Enigmatic 17-year-old high school student Lee Joo-in is a cheerful friend, a shameless daughter, a mischievous girlfriend, and a person always hard to predict. One day, some words she says in a fit of anger cause a major scene. Afterwards, she receives anonymous notes questioning her behavior, and cracks begin to appear in her formerly peaceful world.

 

Will Jooin, who wanted nothing more than to protect her world, be able to go back to how things used to be?

details.title: Kokuho
details.description: The world of Kabuki, the elaborately stylised, male Japanese theatrical tradition, is the setting for director Lee Sang-ilâs epic melodrama of artistic ambition, rivalry and betrayal. It is an adaptation of a bestseller by Shuichi Yoshida, and weaves in stunning stagings of classic Kabuki tales that wowed audiences at Cannes Directorsâ Fortnight. In 1960s Nagasaki, after the death of his yakuza father, gifted teenager Kikuo (Ryo Yoshizawa) is taken under the wing of famed Kabuki actor Hanjiro Hanai (Ken Watanabe), even though the great performer already has a son, Shunsuke (Ryusei Yokohama), who has dedicated his life to the art. Over fifty years, the relationship of the two disciples entwines and twists, and their hearts suffer as much yearning, glory and downfall as their on-stage alter-egos.

details.name: Farewell to my Concubine (4K Restored Version)
details.title: Farewell to my Concubine (4K Restored Version)
details.description:
Douzi, a boy with feminine features, is abandoned by his prostitute mother to an all-boys Peking opera troupe supervised by Master Guan. Douzi befriends fellow trouper Shitou.

A few years later in 1938, a teenage Douzi is trained to play dan (female roles), while Shitou learns jing (painted face male roles). When practicing the play "Dreaming of the World Outside the Nunnery", Douzi intentionally mistakes the line "I am by nature a girl, not a boy" with "I am by nature a boy, not a girl," subjecting himself to severe physical punishments. Douzi along with another student, Laizi, attempt to run away, but Douzi decides to pursue acting seriously after witnessing an opera performance. Upon returning, they find the whole troupe being punished for their desertion, and Douzi is beaten. As a result, Laizi hangs himself...

details.title: HEAT (4K Restoration)
details.description:
Heat is a gripping crime thriller directed by Michael Mann, starring Academy AwardÂ® winners Al Pacino and Robert De Niro. Neil McCauley (Robert De Niro), a highly skilled and disciplined professional thief who leads a crew specializing in high-stakes heists across Los Angeles. On the other side is Vincent Hanna (Al Pacino), a relentless LAPD detective whose dedication to his job matches McCauleyâs commitment to his criminal craft.

As McCauley and his crew plan their biggest score yet, Hanna and his team close in, leading to an intense game of cat and mouse. Both men struggle to balance their personal lives with their professional obsessions, blurring the lines between hunter and hunted. The film builds to a climactic confrontation, exploring themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and the thin line separating lawmen from lawbreakers.

Renowned for its realistic action sequences, complex characters, and the legendary face-off between Pacino and De Niro, Heat is considered a landmark in the crime genre.

details.description:
A stunning 4K restoration of this masterpiece will return to big screen celebrating its 30th anniversary. 

Jules Winnfield and Vincent Vega are two hitmen out to retrieve a suitcase stolen from their employer, mob boss Marsellus Wallace. Wallace has also asked Vincent to take his wife Mia out a few days later when Wallace himself will be out of town. Butch Coolidge is an aging boxer who is paid by Wallace to lose his next fight. Honey Bunny and Pumpkin are a couple of young lovers and small time thieves who decide they need a change of venue. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exhilarating motion picture adventure that both thrills and amuses.
